messages:
deploybot: ALERT: prod-tokenizer canary returning 502 errors and p95 spike at 2026-07-09T11:07:14Z. Auto-rollback blocked (release pinned by compliance). Hotfix image ready: redwood/inference:2026-07-09-hf-tokenizer. Requesting expedited unpin + 30m change window. @mira @alek please ack.

mira: dropping in. paste failing snippet?

deploybot: sample: `502 upstream read error -> tokenizer: invalid chunk boundary at offset 0x1f2` and health probe p95=720ms (baseline 160ms).

alek: sounds like tokenization edge-case with new splitter. hotfix reverts splitter flag and tightens chunk validation. tested in staging, small smoke pass.

ops-oncall: infra check: nodes fine, no IO spike. no other deploys.

mira: need PM/compliance note before we remove pin. sam, can you take release-lead?

sam: i can. require PM signoff on customer notice and that legal is ok with revert. tara (PM) ?

tara: legal looped, ok with revert for stability. i'll update changelog and flag dedicated customers. image will be pinned in notes.

alek: roll plan: lift pin -> canary 5% for 10m -> ramp to 100% if p95 <= baseline*1.25 and errors <0.5%. auto-rollback if thresholds breached.

mira: deploybot, queue command with guard rails and audit tag. freeze new deploys while window open.

deploybot: queued: `/deploy --image redwood/inference:2026-07-09-hf-tokenizer --scope canary --ramp 5% --observe 600s --auto-rollback "p95>+25% || errors>0.5%" --override-pin release-lead-sam --freeze-deploys --audit "unpin-tokenizer-0907"`

sam: +approve (expedite). release lead.

alek: +eng.

tara: +pm-notified. changelog link: https://go/release/2026-07-09-hf-tokenizer

deploybot: APPROVALS: sam, alek, tara. Lifting pin and starting canary. Will post updates every 2m.

deploybot: 11:09 UTC - canary 5% started.

deploybot: 11:17 UTC - telemetry: p95=170ms, errors 0.02% (baseline 160ms). within thresholds.

sam: ok to ramp to 50% over 5m.

ops-oncall: hold for one more check at next window.

deploybot: 11:23 UTC - telemetry check: p95=162ms, errors 0.01%. ops ok.

deploybot: 11:28 UTC - ramp complete to 100%. rollout successful. pin removed. audit saved: unpin-tokenizer-0907.

tara: sending customer notices and updating dedicated changelog.

mira: follow-up: schedule a short postmortem and add a gating test for the splitter edge-case.

ops-oncall: unfreeze complete, no further action. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
